title: CPF Members Using Up Annual Limit of Flexi-MediSave Scheme
what_it_is: CPF Members Using Up Annual Limit of Flexi-MediSave Scheme

sections.label: Flexi-MediSave, CHAS and Merdeka Generation
sections.summary: MOH lowered Flexi-MediSave's minimum age to 60, raised the annual withdrawal limit to $500, added a CHAS green tier and introduced the Merdeka Generation package.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Around 136,000, or 16% of eligible Singaporeans, fully utilised their Flexi-MediSave limit in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Last year, MOH lowered the minimum age criteria for Flexi-MediSave from 65 to 60.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The annual MediSave withdrawal limit for outpatient vaccinations, health screenings and chronic disease management was raised from $400 to $500.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This year, MOH enhanced the CHAS scheme, including introducing a new CHAS green tier to cover all Singaporeans with selected chronic conditions, regardless of income.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We also introduced the Merdeka Generation (MG) package which provides additional subsidies for MG seniors' outpatient treatments at CHAS clinics, polyclinics and public specialist outpatient clinics.

sections.label: Flexi-MediSave usage and review
sections.summary: More than eight in 10 eligible residents do not use the full $200, and the amounts and thresholds will be reviewed and updated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: At this point in time, as I have mentioned earlier, more than eight in 10 of Singapore residents who are eligible to use the Flexi-MediSave do not use the full $200.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, that gives us an indication as to where we have scoped it and the right sizing of that amount at this juncture.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: But as the Member has pointed out, we recognise that there are people who rely on this and we will take this into account as we continue to review and update the amounts and the thresholds.

sections.label: Other schemes and basic healthcare sum
sections.summary: Reaching Flexi-MediSave withdrawal limits does not bar other schemes, and the basic healthcare sum suggestion will be looked at.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Just because you have the Flexi-MediSave withdrawal limits reached or maxed out does not mean you cannot also deploy other schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: But that said, we will look at the suggestion, especially the one that has the basic healthcare sum as a relevant factor to consider in the context of the limits.
